title: Facebook Scraper API
description: Select an operation and enter a Facebook URL or numeric ID.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Select the Facebook endpoint to call.

target.title: Target
target.description: Full Facebook URL for resolve operations. Numeric group or profile ID for other operations.

after.title: Page cursor
after.description: Optional end_cursor from the previous page.

per_page.title: Page size
per_page.description: Optional for profile_feed and group_feed. Defaults to 10.
